repo_notes.content: 请全程使用简体中文撰写 wiki 的所有内容：页面标题、正文、章节说明都用简体中文。代码、命令、文件名、路径、变量名、API 名称保持原样不翻译，也不要加中英对照括号。语气面向初学者，解释直白，少用术语，术语首次出现时用一句话说明

pages.title: Overview
pages.purpose: What yuanbao_bot_client is: a pure-Python WebSocket client for the Tencent Yuanbao Bot (OpenClaw) platform, its two runtime entrypoints (sender.py, group_monitor.py), and repo layout. Links to child pages.

pages.title: Getting Started & Installation
pages.purpose: Termux install.sh bootstrap (mirrors, git lifecycle, ybbot launcher), manual setup, requirements.txt dependencies.

pages.title: Configuration Reference
pages.purpose: config.json / config.example.json keys (APP_KEY, APP_SECRET, API_DOMAIN, WS_URL, DEFAULT_GROUP_CODE, SPAM_INTERVAL, IMAGE_GROUP_CODE, LEXICON_ENABLED), plus .gitignore runtime artifact conventions.

pages.title: Licensing (MIT + GPLv3)
pages.purpose: Dual-license structure inherited from yuanbao-openclaw-plugin and obligations for modifications.

pages.title: Protocol & Transport Layer
pages.purpose: Overview of how the client talks to the Yuanbao gateway: auth signing, WebSocket framing, protobuf codec. Links to children.

pages.title: Authentication & Connection Lifecycle
pages.purpose: HMAC-SHA256 token signing, auth-bind frame, sync_information, heartbeat loop, reconnection with exponential backoff.

pages.title: Protobuf Codec & Message Frames
pages.purpose: SimpleProtobufCodec varint/length-delimited encoding, ConnMsg head fields, cmd types (push/response), request/response correlation via msg_id.

pages.title: TIM Message Elements & Media Uploads
pages.purpose: TIMTextElem/CustomElem/FaceElem/ImageElem/FileElem/VideoFileElem structures, COS upload pipeline for images, files and stickers.

pages.title: Interactive Sender (sender.py)
pages.purpose: Overview of the SpamSender REPL client: architecture, async loops, and command surface. Links to children.

pages.title: Command Reference
pages.purpose: All slash commands: sending, spam control, batch @, group management, user DB, stickers, ai-image, maintenance.

pages.title: Spam Loops & ESC Interruption
pages.purpose: spam_with_at, sticker_spam, replyspam, dmspam, interval control, cbreak-mode _esc_reader/_sleep_with_esc non-blocking interrupt.

pages.title: Terminal UX: Prompt, Autosuggest, Key Bindings
pages.purpose: async_input, PromptSession, CommandAutoSuggest, Ctrl+Q/Ctrl+D/ESC bindings, ASCII banner asset.

pages.title: Auto-Reply and Yuanbao Proxy Mode
pages.purpose: /auto states, push-message hook chain, _proxy_queue FIFO forwarding to IMAGE_GROUP_CODE and quoted-reply relay back.

pages.title: Group Monitor Daemon
pages.purpose: Overview of group_monitor.py: MonitorClient lifecycle, storage and recall handling. Links to children.

pages.title: Message Ingestion & SQLite Store
pages.purpose: MessageStore schema/indices in group_messages.db, _extract_text/_extract_media_info, group_code filtering, add_message.
